# Competitive Edge Physical Therapy

> > Sports-focused physical therapy clinic in San Jose specializing in data-driven rehabilitation, running biomechanics, and performance optimization for athletes.

Competitive Edge Physical Therapy provides evidence-based treatment for endurance athletes, runners, climbers, dancers, and baseball players. The clinic emphasizes injury prevention, biomechanical analysis, and personalized recovery protocols including ACL rehabilitation, running injury management, and return-to-sport progressions.

## Key Topics

- Running biomechanics and form optimization
- ACL reconstruction and rehabilitation
- Medial Tibial Stress Syndrome (shin splints)
- Iliotibial band syndrome
- Injury prevention and recovery protocols
- Performance optimization for athletes
- Knee pain and posterior knee injuries
- Sciatica and sciatic nerve issues
- Maximum Aerobic Function (MAF) training
- Hip pain and gluteal tendinopathy
- Lateral and medial epicondylitis (climbing injuries)
- Sports physical therapy techniques
- Periodization training for endurance athletes
- Lower back pain management
